name: TwoCoasts
description: TwoCoasts brand palette. Inspired by the Arabian Gulf at Dubai, the Andaman coast of Thailand, and links golf: deep water, sunlit sand, fairway green and a sunset ball.

navy.name: Gulf Navy
navy.role: Primary. Headings, body text on light backgrounds, dark surfaces, the lower wave.

teal.name: Andaman Teal
teal.role: Primary accent. Buttons, links, the upper wave, 'coasts' in the wordmark.

tealDeep.name: Deep Teal
tealDeep.role: Accessible teal for text and hover states on light backgrounds.

lagoon.name: Lagoon
lagoon.role: Light tint. Highlights, tags, the upper wave on dark backgrounds.

gold.name: Dubai Gold
gold.role: Secondary accent. The sun/ball, taglines on dark, premium touches. Decorative only on light backgrounds; never text outside the locked logo files.

goldLight.name: Sunlit Gold
goldLight.role: Top of the sun gradient. Use only inside the mark and illustrations.

goldDeep.name: Bunker Gold
goldDeep.role: Dimples on the ball, gold text on light backgrounds.

sand.name: Sand
sand.role: Warm light surface. The sky in the mark, cards, section backgrounds.

green.name: Fairway Green
green.role: Success states, positive numbers, golf-specific accents.

coral.name: Sunset Coral
coral.role: Alerts, errors, negative numbers, urgent highlights.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.role: Body text where navy is too saturated; dark-mode surfaces.

white.name: White
white.role: Text on dark surfaces, reversed logos.

skyDay.name: Dune
skyDay.role: Sky inside the day mark only. Not a UI colour.

skyNight.name: Night Gulf
skyNight.role: Sky inside the night mark only. Also the midpoint of the Coast gradient.
